maria (DevEx): quick follow-up from today's all-hands — can we get a concise sequence for API / Console / Optimize rollouts? need canary windows + owners so we can schedule SDK docs and a short webinar.

samir (PM): short version: API GA path first (canary -> gradual), Console feature parity after API canary, Optimize enters beta while Console finishes. owners: API infra (elaine), Console UX (maria), Optimize (me).

elaine (Staff Eng): confirmed — API canary next Tue 9am PT. plan: dark launch, 2% traffic, smoke tests, 24h SLO watch, then 10% if clean. runbook is in the runbooks repo. example deploy command:
```
ci/deploy --service api --version v2.3.0 --canary --percent 2
```
Also need to coordinate token migration in SDK before GA.

ana (CEO): (note: use "ana (CEO)")
ana (CEO): sorry typo above. Appreciate the windows — for enterprise customers we need a privacy/hardening checklist before Console GA. ops/security to own. @julian can you take point?

julian (Security): will do. target ready by Console canary. one flag to call out: Optimize telemetry defaults — we need an explicit opt-out for Private deployments and a clear data flow doc.

maria (DevEx): on SDK impact: are we changing any call signatures? example we use now: `client.generate({model: "redwood-1.1", streaming: true})` — will that break?

samir (PM): no breaking changes planned. new params for Optimize/console will be optional; we expect a minor SDK bump and a migration note.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: api-service v2.3.0 -> 2% traffic -> 2024-05-20T16:00:00Z

elaine (Staff Eng): one more infra note: Dedicated capacity needs a config flag surfaced in the Console before GA. @kevin can you confirm autoscale flags and whether we can show them in the UI?

kevin (Infra): confirmed — dedicated autoscale exists (`--dedicated=true`, `--autoscale-min`, `--autoscale-max`). need a tiny API tweak to return current pool sizes for the Console dashboard. will file a ticket.

maria (DevEx): great — I'll open the SDK docs PR for Thursday and schedule a 30min "what's changing" session next Wed. also will add a short checklist for support to the runbook.

samir (PM): summary for me: owners = API: elaine, Console: maria, Optimize: samir. API canary Tue; Console canary ~2 weeks after API stable; Optimize staggered 3-week beta cadence. I'll update the roadmap doc and ping leads.

ana (CEO): :thumbsup: thanks all.

maria (DevEx): ack, thanks everyone, will follow up with links + PRs in this thread.
